title: Sardar Patel Planetarium, Vadodara - A Journey Through the Universe
content:
Sardar Patel Planetarium, Vadodara

Located inside the lush Sayaji Baug (Kamati Baug), the Sardar Patel Planetarium in Vadodara is one of Gujarat’s most fascinating and educational attractions. Established in 1974, this planetarium is dedicated to India’s Iron Man, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, and serves as a center for space science learning and celestial exploration.

The planetarium is a must-visit for both students and astronomy enthusiasts, offering an immersive experience that brings the mysteries of the universe closer to Earth.

About the Planetarium

The Sardar Patel Planetarium was built with the vision of promoting scientific awareness and curiosity about the cosmos among the public. The planetarium features a dome-shaped projection theater, where visitors can watch engaging 3D and digital shows about stars, planets, galaxies, and the vast universe.

Each show uses modern audio-visual technology, including surround sound and realistic projections, making it a captivating experience for all age groups. The educational content is easy to understand, blending science with entertainment.

Shows and Experience

Daily shows are organized in three languages – English, Hindi, and Gujarati, to cater to a diverse audience. The main highlight is the cosmic journey show, which takes visitors through the solar system, constellations, and the evolution of galaxies.

The planetarium’s 20-meter dome and comfortable seating arrangement enhance the overall experience, giving you a feeling of being truly under the night sky.

Surroundings and Attractions

Situated within Sayaji Baug, one of Vadodara’s most beautiful public gardens, the planetarium shares space with other major attractions like the Baroda Museum & Picture Gallery, Sayaji Zoo, and the Toy Train Ride. After attending a show, visitors can relax in the garden or explore the nearby attractions, making it a perfect half-day family outing spot.

Location

Sayaji Baug, Near Kala Ghoda Circle, Vadodara, Gujarat - 390018

Timings

  • Tuesday to Sunday: 10:30 AM - 6:00 PM
  • Show Timings: 12:00 PM (English), 3:00 PM (Hindi), 4:00 PM (Gujarati)
  • Closed: Monday and Public Holidays

Entry Fee

  • Adults: ₹10 per person
  • Children: ₹5 per person

Special shows or group bookings: Extra charges may apply.

How to Reach

  • By Air: Vadodara Airport is about 6 km away.
  • By Train: Vadodara Junction is just 2 km from Sayaji Baug.
  • By Road: Easily accessible by local autos, buses, or taxis.

  • Sursagar Lake - A calm lake ideal for evening walks.
  • Laxmi Vilas Palace - The grand royal residence of the Gaekwad family. Read more..
  • Kirti Mandir - A beautiful memorial of Vadodara’s royal heritage. Read more..

faqs.question: Where is Sardar Patel Planetarium located?
faqs.answer: It is located inside Sayaji Baug (Kamati Baug) near Kala Ghoda Circle in Vadodara, Gujarat.

faqs.question: What is Sardar Patel Planetarium famous for?
faqs.answer: It’s famous for its 3D space shows about stars, planets, and galaxies, offering a fun and educational experience for all ages.

faqs.question: What are the show timings at Sardar Patel Planetarium?
faqs.answer: Shows are held daily (except Monday) - 12:00 PM in English, 3:00 PM in Hindi, and 4:00 PM in Gujarati.

faqs.question: What is the entry fee for Sardar Patel Planetarium?
faqs.answer: The entry fee is ₹10 for adults and ₹5 for children.

faqs.question: Is photography allowed inside the planetarium?
faqs.answer: Photography is usually not allowed inside during the shows, but visitors can take photos outside the building.
